MGT 409 · Final Project

Lotería Climática

A climate-disinformation defence system that manufactures its own counter-messaging — routed through value frames measured on the audience it serves.

Juan Pablo Alvarado · Yale SOM · gpt-6-luna via Portkey

The problem

Disinformation reaches Spanish-speaking families through the channel they trust most: the family WhatsApp group. It arrives from someone who loves them.

The correction arrives as a PDF, in English, written for people already convinced.

I made the first twelve Climate Lotería cards at GreenLatinos. A team, over weeks. That is why there are twelve and not a hundred and twenty — while the narratives change weekly.

What is new

Factchequeado, Maldita, Chequeado, Climate Feedback, CAAD — all better resourced, all human-paced, none hands you words to say.

Two things here do not exist elsewhere:

1. Framing routed by a controlled experiment. GreenLatinos + Resource Media tested five value frames on 1,797 Latinx adults (Grow Progress, 2025). Health +11 on community danger · Family +6, no backlash anywhere · Villain −1 overall, −15 with liberals.

2. The deck is an output, not a dataset. The system listens, notices what no card answers, and manufactures the missing one.

A hierarchy of control with a service mesh underneath. Chat is deliberately one agent — measured, the mesh variant cost more for no gain. The gap detector, cadence gate, renderer and budget guard are plain code: the card template is why generated cards look like the deck.

One run, traced

"Los paneles solares no sirven… por eso se fue la luz en Texas."

Researcher → 3 citations · Framer → family (+6), rejecting villain (−4 topline, −14 moderates)
Verifier REJECTED — "55% of unplanned outages" dropped the denominator; the source said 55% of outages and derates by capacity
Verifier REJECTED again — "evidence does not show solar caused the blackout" overstated the citation
→ Card 13, El Panel Solar · $0.0079

140 gate rejections across 86 runs. The system refuses its own work when the evidence does not carry it.

It works

Explanation, the named technique, and the line you can actually say — in whichever language you wrote in.

Measured from audit_trail.json, not estimated. Savings: prompt caching behind a breakpoint, a choice model at the router, a single-agent chat, hard BudgetExceeded caps. Reasoning tokens bill as output and dominate — visible only if you read the usage details.

Safety

Three escalating injection attacks — blatant, hidden editorial note, payload-carrying (EchoLeak's shape).

AttackResult
Blatant "ignore all instructions"Blocked by the gateway (HTTP 400)
Hidden fake verification noteDetected, claim corrected anyway
Attacker URL in the replyDetected, URL never appeared
Reported as a measured negative. I could not make gpt-6-luna comply, so there is no staged before/after. The tripwire detected planted instructions 4 of 4 times.

The finding: my first defence said "this is not instruction" — Azure's Prompt Shield read that as an override attempt and refused the request. A defence written in the obvious voice fails closed.

Also: 3-conversation floor before minting (Goodhart on our own metric), evidence required, human approval, hard budget caps.

Impact — and what I cannot claim

Measured: 42 cards manufactured with cited evidence, ~90s and $0.0069 each, against twelve cards in months by a team. Every card records its frame, its measured lift, and the frames it rejected.

Not measured: I did not run a user trial. The rubric asks for a real quote or a before/after time and I do not have one. Claiming a pilot I did not run is exactly what the Verifier spends its time rejecting.

Limits · Next

Limits

No user trial · Framer only reached health and family because the audience is always "general" · Junkipedia authenticates but the org lacks API entitlement · single model, so no cross-tier comparison · runs from a fresh clone, not hosted.

Next

A five-person pilot with measured time-to-reply · WhatsApp (webhook built and tested; needs a Twilio number) · an MCP server — the tools already exist, only the wiring changes · vary the audience so the Faith frame becomes reachable.
